blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Here, we present TOX-FM, a family of non-clinical PFMs trained on large-scale diverse histopathology datasets of over one million whole slide images consisting of over 60 organs across six animal species from over 14,000 toxicology studies across six decades. We introduce a comprehensive benchmark of 18 non-clinical downstream tasks, incorporate an established benchmark of 9 clinical downstream tasks, and evaluate TOX-FM against state-of-the-art clinical PFMs across both non-clinical and clinical domains. Notably, we explore open questions surrounding domain-specific training and cross-domain generalization, offering insights into the opportunities and challenges of applying PFMs in the non-clinical domain.
blocks.zh: 这里,我们介绍TOX-FM,一个非临床PFM的家族,经过培训,拥有超过一百万个完整的幻灯片图像的大规模多样化组织病理学数据集,由六类动物的60多个器官组成,来自六十年来14 000多起毒理学研究。 我们引入了18个非临床下游任务的综合基准,纳入9个临床下游任务的既定基准,对TOX-FM进行跨非临床和临床领域的最新临床PFM评价. 值得注意的是,我们探讨围绕特定领域培训和跨领域通用的开放问题,使人们深入了解在非临床领域应用PFM的机会和挑战。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Toxicology studies are a cornerstone of the drug development pipeline for novel therapeutics.
While the preclinical phase is most critical, providing key evidence to enable the transition from early research to first-in-human clinical trials, toxicology studies are conducted throughout the entire drug development continuum, extending from early discovery through clinical development and post-marketing settings.
At every stage, the safety and toxicity of drug candidates are evaluated in animal models to identify potential adverse effects and to support ongoing risk assessments.
Central to this effort, histopathology examinations across multiple tissues and animal species are performed by toxicologic pathologists in a labor-intensive and time-consuming process, particularly as most tissues examined may not exhibit any drug-related microscopic changes.
The Society of Toxicologic Pathology and other professional groups in pathology and related disciplines have highlighted how artificial intelligence may address some of the current challenges to synergistically improve a pathologist’s individual and collective diagnostic efficiency, improving the overall workflow and shortening study timelines [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh:
毒理学研究是新疗法药物开发管道的基石。
虽然临床前阶段最为关键,为能够从早期研究过渡到先入为主的临床试验提供了关键证据,但毒理学研究在整个药物开发连续体中进行,从早期发现一直延伸到临床发展和上市后环境.
在每个阶段,都要通过动物模型对药物候选者的安全性和毒性进行评估,以确定潜在的不利影响,并支持正在进行的风险评估。
在这项努力中,毒理学病理学家对多个组织和动物物种进行组织病理学检查是劳动密集型和耗时的过程,特别是因为大多数接受检查的组织可能不会显示出任何与药物有关的微观变化。
毒理学病理学学会和其他病理学和相关学科专业团体都强调了人工智能如何应对当前一些挑战,即协同提高病理学家个人和集体诊断效率,改进总体工作流程并缩短学习时间表[1,2,3,4]。

blocks.en:
In recent years, many state-of-the-art pathology foundation models (PFMs) have been developed using self-supervised learning frameworks [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] on large-scale unlabeled datasets of whole slide images (WSIs) [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] .
PFMs learn generalizable task-agnostic representations of the underlying data and provide broad support for task-specific machine learning models by enabling efficient adaptation to multiple downstream tasks with relatively limited labeled datasets [ 18 ] .
The development of PFMs has been driven primarily by clinical applications, particularly oncology, whereas non-clinical PFMs remain comparatively underexplored.
This is partly due to the limited availability of large-scale non-clinical datasets, with most development to date relying on the publicly available TG-GATES dataset, which consists only of rat liver and kidney tissues [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] .
Additionally, many existing clinical PFMs are subjected to restrictions on commercial use, which may limit their integration into drug development pipelines.
Importantly, the lack of non-clinical PFMs also leaves several important questions unresolved: How critical is domain-specific training for PFMs for downstream task performance?
How well do clinical PFMs generalize to the non-clinical domain, and vice versa?
Addressing these questions is essential for understanding cross-domain generalization and the scope of potential applications of PFMs, as well as whether it is necessary to direct more focus towards the development of non-clinical PFMs.
blocks.zh:
近年来,许多先进的病理学基础模型(PFMS)被开发出来,使用自我监督的学习框架[5,6,7,8,9,10]在大型无标签的全滑图像数据集上[11,12,13,14,15,16,17].
PFMs学习了基本数据的可通用任务不可知性表述,并通过能高效地适应多个下游任务,并使用相对有限的标签数据集[18],为特定任务机器学习模型提供广泛的支持.
PFM的开发主要受临床应用,特别是肿瘤学的驱动,而非临床PFM的开发仍然相对不足.
这部分是由于大规模非临床数据集的提供有限,迄今为止大部分开发依赖于公开的TG-GATES数据集,该数据集仅由老鼠肝和肾组织组成[19,20,21].
此外,许多现有的临床PFM受到商业使用限制,这可能限制它们融入药物开发管道。
重要的是,缺乏非临床PFM也留下了几个重要问题未解决: 对于下游任务业绩而言,针对特定域的PFM培训有多重要?
临床的PFM对非临床领域的概括程度如何,反之亦然?
解决这些问题对于理解跨域通用和PFM潜在应用范围,以及是否有必要更注重非临床PFM的发展至关重要.

blocks.en:
In this work, we address key gaps in the development and evaluation of foundation models for histopathology by introducing TOX-FM, a family of PFMs trained on large-scale diverse histopathology datasets from animal toxicology studies.
TOX-FM establishes a benchmark for non-clinical PFMs and provides early insights into the cross-domain generalization capabilities of existing clinical PFMs.
Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们通过引进TOX-FM,解决在发展和评价组织病理学基础模型方面的主要差距,这是一个接受动物毒理学研究中大规模多样化组织病理学数据集培训的PFM家族.
TOX-FM为非临床PFM建立了基准,并提供了对现有临床PFM的跨域通用能力的早期见解.
我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en:
• A family of large-scale non-clinical PFMs. We present TOX-FM, a family of non-clinical PFMs trained using the DINOv3 self-supervised learning framework [ 22 ] on over one million WSIs consisting of over 60 organs across six animal species from over 14,000 toxicology studies across six decades.
To the best of our knowledge, TOX-FM is trained on the largest and most diverse non-clinical histopathology dataset to date and is the first non-clinical PFM to scale beyond the previously limited scope of rat liver and kidney tissues. • A computationally efficient multi-scale dataset curation
strategy. We use a hierarchical clustering and sampling approach for dataset curation and introduce a progressive multi-scale strategy that operates across magnifications.
This strategy addresses the practical challenge of scaling training to one million WSIs under a fixed computational budget, while producing a highly diverse yet computationally compact training dataset. • A comprehensive cross-domain benchmark. We introduce a comprehensive benchmark of 18 non-clinical downstream tasks, incorporate an established benchmark of 9 clinical downstream tasks, and evaluate TOX-FM against state-of-the-art clinical PFMs across both non-clinical and clinical domains.
To the best of our knowledge, this provides the first systematic evaluation of cross-domain generalization of PFMs. • An empirical study of scaling and training strategies. We analyze the impact of scaling model size and dataset diversity, and quantify the contributions of various complementary training
strategies, including continual learning and Gram anchoring.
These analyses provide practical and actionable guidance for future development of PFMs.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Dataset Scaling and Curation. Recent work in the natural vision-language domain has demonstrated that naively increasing the dataset size can be less effective for representation learning, compared to selecting higher quality subsets of available data or more diverse data distributions, especially for similar compute budgets [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] .
These considerations also apply to large language models, whereby quality-based pruning can retain only a fraction of the available corpus while matching or exceeding the performance of the full dataset [ 26 ] .
Collectively, these studies suggest that the selection of informative and diverse samples provides a more compute-efficient training signal compared to random sampling, thereby motivating a dataset curation strategy when scaling the dataset to one million WSIs.
blocks.zh:
数据集缩放和校正 。 最近自然视觉语言领域的工作表明,天真地增加数据集的大小对于表现学习可能不太有效,相比之下,选择质量更高的现有数据子集或更多样化的数据分布,尤其是对于类似的计算预算[23,24,25].
这些考虑也适用于大型语言模型,即基于质量的查勘只能保留一小部分现有套件,同时匹配或超过完整数据集的性能[26].
这些研究表明,与随机取样相比,选择信息丰富和多样的样本可提供更具有计算效率的训练信号,从而在将数据集扩大至一百万瓦西里时推动数据集的校准策略。

blocks.en:
Generalization Under Domain Shifts. To the best of our knowledge, the robustness of PFMs under domain shifts has been studied exclusively in the clinical setting, with prior work focusing on technical factors such as processing and imaging sites [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 ] , scanner types [ 32 , 33 ] , and staining conditions [ 34 ] .
A smaller body of work has examined domain shifts related to biological or disease-relevant factors.
For example, previous work has demonstrated that clinical PFMs trained on hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) slides from datasets focused on cancer may not generalize well to multi-stain immunohistochemistry slides from datasets focused on autoimmune diseases, with several PFMs performing no better or worse than natural image models [ 35 ] .
Performance degradation has also been reported for zero-shot cross-cancer evaluations, although the addition of handcrafted biologically motivated descriptors mitigated the loss in performance [ 36 ] .
blocks.zh:
域移下通论. 据我们所知,域外转移的PFM的稳健性只在临床环境中研究过,以前的工作侧重于技术因素,如加工和成像场地[27、28、29、30、31]、扫描仪类型[32、33]和污渍条件[34]。
一小部分工作审查了与生物或疾病相关因素有关的领域变化。
例如,先前的研究表明,接受过血氧素和eosin(H&E)等临床PFM从以癌症为重点的数据集中获取的幻灯片可能无法很好地概括为以自体免疫疾病为重点的数据集的多斑免疫生化幻灯片,几个PFM的性能并不比自然图像模型更好或更差[35].
还报告了零发横癌评价的性能退化情况,尽管增加了手动生物活性描述符减轻了性能损失[36].

blocks.en:
Importantly, cross-species domain shifts remain largely unexplored [ 4 ] .
Some relevant work in this direction includes adversarial training on canine tumors for generalization of a mitosis detection model to human tumors [ 37 ] and fine-tuning natural image models on rodent liver WSIs [ 38 ] .
However, the bidirectional generalization of learned image representations between non-clinical animal pathology and clinical human pathology has not been systematically evaluated for PFMs.
blocks.zh:
重要的是,跨物种域转移基本上仍未被探索 [4].
这方面的一些相关工作包括:就犬瘤进行对抗性训练,将弥陀菌检测模型通向人类肿瘤[37],并细化了啮齿类肝脏WSI上的自然影像模型[38].
然而,在非临床动物病理学和临床人类病理学之间对所学图像表现的双向概括还没有对PFM进行系统评价.

blocks.en: 3 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 数据集

blocks.en:
The dataset consisted primarily of H&E WSIs from toxicology studies conducted by Novartis Biomedical Research across global sites.
The studies consisted of approximately 75% rodent (rat and mouse) and 25% non-rodent (dog, monkey, pig, and rabbit) species, ranging from acute (two weeks) to lifelong (two years) carcinogenicity studies.
blocks.zh:
数据集主要包括诺华生物医学研究在全球各地进行的毒理学研究产生的H & E WSI。
这些研究包括约75%的啮齿动物(大鼠和老鼠)和25%的非啮齿动物(狗、猴子、猪和兔子),从急性(两周)到终生(两年)致癌性研究。

blocks.en:
The training datasets were collected in two phases.
In the first phase, 100,000 WSIs from rat studies conducted between 1999 and 2024 were obtained from existing internal digital databases.
In the second phase, 1 million WSIs were acquired by digitizing archived glass slides from legacy rodent and non-rodent studies conducted from as early as 1967.
We refer to the datasets as TOX-FM-100K and TOX-FM-1M , respectively.
There was no overlap between the studies in the two training datasets.
blocks.zh:
培训数据集分两个阶段收集。
在第一阶段,从现有的内部数字数据库中获得了1999年至2024年进行的老鼠研究的10万个WSI.
在第二阶段,通过从早在1967年就进行的遗留啮齿动物和非啮齿动物研究中将存档玻璃幻灯片数字化,获得了100万个WSI.
我们把数据集分别称为TOX-FM-100K和TOX-FM-1M.
这两个培训数据集的研究没有重叠之处。

blocks.en:
Overall, TOX-FM-100K was a less diverse dataset, consisting of WSIs from 700 rat studies only, while TOX-FM-1M was a more diverse dataset, consisting of WSIs from 13,352 studies across six species (rat, mouse, dog, monkey, pig, and rabbit).
Additionally, TOX-FM-1M included more studies that were conducted at different contract research organizations, which introduced further variation in staining and scanning protocols, thereby increasing diversity.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,TOX-FM-100K是一个不太多样化的数据集,由仅来自700个大鼠研究的WSI组成,而TOX-FM-1M则是一个比较多样化的数据集,由来自6个物种(大鼠,老鼠,狗,猴子,猪和兔子)的13,352个研究的WSI组成.
此外,TOX-FM-1M还包括在不同的合同研究组织进行的更多研究,这些研究对污渍和扫描协议带来了进一步的变化,从而增加了多样性。

blocks.en:
Patches (256 × 256 pixels) were sampled from the WSIs at multiple magnifications for training.
For TOX-FM-100K , all non-overlapping patches from tissue regions were sampled at 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, and 4.0 microns per pixel (mpp), resulting in approximately 1 billion patches.
For TOX-FM-1M , a dataset curation method was implemented to sample a subset of patches, motivated by recent research on scaling dataset size for vision foundation models [ 10 , 22 ] , as well as practical considerations such as storage and computational constraints.
The dataset curation resulted in a diverse and compact dataset of approximately 463 million patches, corresponding to approximately 4.4% of patches selected from a candidate pool of 10.5 billion patches across all magnifications.
blocks.zh:
补丁(256×256像素)在多次放大时从WSI中取出样本进行训练.
对于TOX-FM-100K,组织区域的所有非重叠补丁被取样为每像素(mpp)0.5,1.0,2.0和4.0微米,结果有约10亿补丁.
对于TOX-FM-1M, 采用了数据集校正方法来取出一组补丁, 其动机是最近对视觉基础模型的缩放数据集大小的研究[10, 22], 以及存储和计算制约等实际考虑.
数据集拼接导致一个大约4.63亿个补丁的多样而紧凑的数据集,相当于从所有放大的105亿个候选补丁库中挑选的补丁的约4.4%。

blocks.en:
We used a progressive multi-scale strategy for sampling patches across the different magnifications, with selection proceeding from the lowest magnification (4.0 mpp) to the highest magnification (0.5 mpp).
At the lowest magnification, all non-overlapping patches from tissue regions from all WSIs were defined as candidate patches for selection.
Candidate patches at each subsequent higher magnification were restricted to those located within the regions of the selected patches at the preceding lower magnification. Figure 2 B shows examples of the spatially linked selected patches across magnifications.
blocks.zh:
我们使用渐进式的多尺度策略来对不同放大的补丁进行取样,选择过程从最小放大(4.0 mpp)到最高放大(0.5 mpp).
在最小放大时,来自所有世界安全组织组织区域的所有非重叠补丁被定义为供选择的候选人补丁.
候选人的补丁在其后每次较高放大时,仅限于在先前较低放大时所选补丁所在区域内的补丁。 图 2个 B 显示跨放大的空间连接所选补丁的例子 。

blocks.en:
We used a hierarchical k-means approach [ 39 ] for the selection of patches, applying the method to candidate patches at each magnification.
First, Midnight-12k [ 17 ] was used to generate embeddings for all candidate patches.
The embeddings at each magnification were independently projected into a lower dimensional space using principal component analysis (PCA) to reduce the computational cost of clustering.
Then, k-means clustering was applied to the embeddings and recursively applied to the resulting centroids, yielding a bottom-up four-level hierarchy of clusters.
Given a target subset size, the quota was distributed top-down from the from the root clusters to the leaf clusters, where individual patches were finally selected.
Specifically, at each level, the number of samples allocated to a parent cluster was uniformly distributed among its child clusters.
If a child cluster had fewer samples than the allocated quota, the additional quota was reallocated to the remaining child clusters of the same parent. Figure 2 A shows the UMAP visualization of the hierarchical clustering results for the lowest magnification.
blocks.zh:
我们在选择补丁时采用了分级k-表示法[39],每次放大时将方法应用到候选补丁上.
首先,Midnight-12k [17] 用于生成所有候选补丁的嵌入.
每次放大时的嵌入被独立地投放到下维空间中,利用主组件分析(PCA)来降低集群的计算成本.
随后,k-意为集群被应用到嵌入体上并递归地被应用到所生成的百分子上,产生自下而上四级分层集群.
鉴于目标子集大小,配额从根子集到叶子集由上而下分配,最终选择了单个补丁.
具体地说,在每一级别,分配给一个家长小组的样本数量都统一分配给其儿童小组。
如果一个儿童组的样本少于分配的配额,则将额外配额重新分配给同一父母剩余的儿童组。 图 2个 A显示最小放大的分级群集结果的UMAP可视化.

blocks.en:
Overall, the dataset curation strategy for TOX-FM-1M yielded spatially linked subsets of patches across magnifications.
By balancing the selected patches across the hierarchical levels within a magnification, the method reduced the redundancy of common histological patterns, while preserving diverse and under-represented phenotypes.
Across magnifications, rare tissue types were oversampled relative to the sampling ratio in most cases.
More details of the settings used for the hierarchical k-means approach and a validation analysis of the method are provided in Appendix 1 .
blocks.zh:
总的来说,TOX-FM-1M的数据集校正战略产生了跨放大的空间相连接的补丁子集.
通过在放大范围内平衡不同等级层次的所选补丁,该方法减少了常见的神学模式的冗余,同时保留了多样性和代表性不足的苯基.
在大多数情况下,稀有组织类型在抽样比例上都受到过度抽样。
附录1提供了分级k-表示法所使用的设置的更详细情况和对该方法的验证分析。

blocks.en: 4 Training
blocks.zh: 4 培训

blocks.en:
We used the DINOv3 self-supervised learning framework [ 22 ] with student-teacher distillation to train Vision Transformer (ViT) models.
We trained ViT-L (305M parameters) and ViT-H (636M parameters) models with the different versions of the datasets to investigate the effects of scaling model size and dataset diversity.
Given the sequential nature of the datasets, which were collected in two phases, we also explored a continual learning strategy to integrate knowledge from both datasets while maintaining efficient use of computational resources.
Additionally, all models were fine-tuned with the Gram anchoring strategy, which was proposed in DINOv3 to improve dense feature representations, to investigate the effects on spatially resolved downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们用DINOv3自我监督的学习框架[22] 与学生-教师蒸馏来训练Vision Transformer(ViT)模型.
我们用不同版本的数据集培训了Vit-L(305M参数)和Vit-H(636M参数)模型,以调查缩放模型大小和数据集多样性的影响.
鉴于数据集的相继性质,这些数据集分两个阶段收集,我们还探索了一项持续学习战略,以综合两个数据集的知识,同时保持对计算资源的有效利用。
此外,所有模型都与Gram锚定战略进行了微调,在DINOv3中提出了该战略,以改进密集地物的特征表述,调查对空间解决下游任务的影响。

blocks.en:
Augmentations. Models were trained using the multi-crop strategy [ 40 ] , by applying random cropping scales and using 2 global crops (256 × 256 pixels) and 8 local crops (112 × 112 pixels) per patch.
Geometric augmentations in the form of horizontal and vertical flipping and color augmentations in the form of Gaussian blurring and RandStainNA [ 41 ] were applied with varying probabilities.
For RandStainNA, the statistical parameters for virtual template generation were estimated from a random subset of 12,000 WSIs from TOX-FM-100K .
blocks.zh:
增减相. 通过采用随机收成尺度和每块地用2个全球作物(256×256像素)和8个地用作物(112×112像素)对模型进行培训。
以水平和垂直翻转为形式的几何增强和以高斯模糊和RandStainNA[41]为形式的颜色增强应用了各种概率。
对于兰德斯泰恩 NA,虚拟模板生成的统计参数是从TOX-FM-100K的12,000个WSI的随机子集中估算出来的.

blocks.en:
Optimization. Models were trained using 16 or 32 NVIDIA H100 GPUs for ViT-L or ViT-H, respectively.
Patches were sampled with equal probability from each magnification for balanced multi-scale training.
Models were trained for up to 2 million iterations using AdamW optimization [ 42 ] with a constant learning rate following a linear warmup.
blocks.zh:
优化. 模型分别使用16个或32个NVIDIA H100 GPU用于VIT-L或VIT-H进行训练.
对补丁进行了取样,每次放大的概率相等,以便进行均衡的多规模培训。
使用 AdamW 优化[42] 对最多200万次迭代进行模型培训,在线性热身后,不断学习。

blocks.en:
Checkpoint Selection. 12,451 WSIs from 246 studies across all six species were used as a validation dataset to design downstream tasks for model development.
For each model, the average performance across four non-clinical tasks was monitored every 50,000 iterations and the checkpoint with the overall best performance was selected.
Specifically, the validation downstream tasks consisted of species, tissue (rat), artifact, and lesion patch classification using linear probe.
More details of the non-clinical downstream tasks are provided in the Evaluation section.
blocks.zh:
检查点选择。 12 451个 来自所有六个物种的246个研究的WPI被用作验证数据集来设计模型开发的下游任务.
对每种模式,每50 000次重复监测四个非临床任务的平均业绩,选择了表现总体最佳的检查站。
具体地说,验证的下游任务包括物种,组织(大鼠),文物,并使用线性探测器进行损伤补丁分类.
关于非临床下游任务的更详细情况载于评价部分。

blocks.en:
Continual Learning. We explored a continual pre-training strategy [ 43 , 44 ] whereby the model was initialized with existing weights from training on TOX-FM-100K from the first phase, and training was continued on TOX-FM-1M in the second phase.
The training in the second phase was limited to 1 million iterations.
This reflects a practical real-world scenario whereby foundation models are continuously updated as new datasets become available, with sequential training strategies that preserve previous training efforts and significantly reduce computational costs.
In contrast, joint training strategies, such as retraining from scratch with progressively larger combined datasets, quickly become unsustainable and have been shown to yield diminishing returns relative to continual learning [ 45 ] .
blocks.zh:
相续修习. 我们探索了一项持续的培训前战略[43、44],根据该战略,该模式从第一阶段的TOX-FM-100K培训中以现有重量开始,第二阶段的TOX-FM-1M培训继续进行。
第二阶段的培训限于100万次重复。
这反映了一种现实世界的实际情况,即随着新数据集的提供,基础模型不断得到更新,并有连续的培训战略,以保持以往的培训努力并大大减少计算费用。
与此相反,联合培训战略,例如从零开始使用逐渐扩大的综合数据集进行再培训,很快就变得不可持续,而且与持续学习相比,已经证明回报会减少[45]。

blocks.en:
Gram Anchoring. The Gram anchoring objective operates on the Gram matrix, which is the matrix of all pairwise dot products of patch features, and aims to push the Gram matrix of the student network towards that of the Gram teacher, which is an earlier checkpoint of the teacher network that typically exhibits superior dense features [ 22 ] .
For Gram teacher checkpoint selection, we followed the same approach described in the Checkpoint Selection section, but focused only on artifact and lesion tasks, as the quality of the dense features should be best reflected by the performance on these spatially resolved downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:
奶奶安乔林。 格莱姆定位目标运行在格莱姆矩阵上,这是补丁特征的所有对等点产品的矩阵,旨在将学生网络的格莱姆矩阵推向格莱克教师的矩阵,这是教师网络较早的检查点,通常显示出优越的密集特征[22].
关于格鲁玛教师检查站的选择,我们采用了检查点选择部分所述的同样方法,但只侧重于文物和损伤任务,因为密集特征的质量最好通过这些空间解决下游任务的表现来体现。

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: 5.1 Pathology Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 5.1 病理学基础模型

blocks.en: We evaluated both non-clinical and clinical PFMs to assess domain-specific performance and cross-domain generalization. Table 1 shows an overview of the PFMs.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了非临床和临床的PFM,以评估特定域的性能和跨域通论. 表1显示PFM的概况。

blocks.en:
Table 1: Overview of non-clinical and clinical PFMs for evaluation.
The number of parameters for ViT-L, ViT-H, and ViT-g architectures are approximately 305M, 636M, and 1.1B parameters, respectively.
blocks.zh:
表1:用于评价的非临床和临床PFM的概况.
ViT-L,ViT-H,和ViT-g架构的参数数分别约为305M,636M和1.1B等参数.

blocks.en:
Non-Clinical Models. First, we developed TOX-FM-100K-ViT-L and TOX-FM-100K-ViT-H to evaluate the effects of scaling model size.
While most state-of-the-art PFMs adopt ViT-g (1.1B parameters) architectures, we explored whether ViT-L and ViT-H architectures, which are approximately 30 – 60% of the size of ViT-g, remain competitive with significantly reduced computational costs.
Second, we developed TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H to evaluate the effects of scaling dataset diversity and training with curated datasets, as well as to provide a baseline for the continual learning strategy.
Finally, we developed TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL, which was initialized from TOX-FM-100K-ViT-H, to evaluate the continual learning strategy used to integrate knowledge from datasets collected in different phases.
Additionally, we fine-tuned all models with the Gram anchoring objective on their respective training datasets and refer to the corresponding models with the -Gram suffix.
blocks.zh:
非临床模型. 首先,我们开发了TOX-FM-100K-ViT-L和TOX-FM-100K-ViT-H来评价缩放模型大小的效果.
虽然大多数最先进的PFM采用了Vit-g(1.1B参数)架构,但我们探讨了Vit-L和Vit-H架构(大约为Vit-g规模的30-60%)是否仍然与大幅降低的计算成本相竞争.
第二,我们开发了TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H,以评价数据集多样性的规模化和用所编集的数据集进行培训的效果,并为持续学习战略提供基线。
最后,我们开发了TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL,它由TOX-FM-100K-ViT-H初始化而来,用于评价用于整合不同阶段所收集的数据集中的知识的持续学习策略.
此外,我们用格拉姆定位目标调整了所有模型在各自的训练数据集上,并参照了带有-Gram后缀的相应模型。

blocks.en:
Clinical Models. We evaluated state-of-the-art clinical PFMs with licenses that permit commercial use.
Specifically, we evaluated Prov-GigaPath [ 12 ] , H-optimus-0 [ 13 ] , and Midnight-12k [ 17 ] , which were trained on various public and proprietary clinical datasets and have demonstrated strong performance across various clinical pathology benchmarks [ 46 , 47 , 48 ] .
All models were accessed via the official versions published on Hugging Face.
blocks.zh:
临床模型. 我们评估了最先进的临床PFM, 并颁发了允许商业用途的许可证。
具体来说,我们评价了Prov-Gigapath [12],H-opimus-0 [13],和Midnight-12k [17],它们接受了各种公共和专有临床数据集的培训,并表现出了跨越各种临床病理学基准的强劲表现[46,47,48].
所有模型都通过Hugging Face上公布的官方版本访问.

blocks.en:
Natural Image Models. As baselines, we included out-of-domain models trained on non-pathology datasets.
Specifically, we evaluated a ViT-B (86M parameters) model trained on the ImageNet dataset of 1.2 million images [ 49 , 50 ] and the ViT-L variant (distilled from ViT-7B) of the original DINOv3 model trained on the LVD-1689M web-scale dataset of 1.689 billion images [ 22 ] .
Although web-scale data may contain some biomedical or pathology-related images, such content is expected to represent only a small fraction of LVD-1689M, which is predominantly composed of natural images.
Accordingly, ImageNet-ViT-B provides a lower bound baseline of a small natural image model, whereas DINOv3-LVD-1689M-ViT-L provides a strong baseline of an architecture-matched general vision foundation model.
blocks.zh:
自然图像模型. 作为基线,我们列入了非病理学数据集培训的域外模型。
具体来说,我们评价了在120万个图像[49,50]的ImageNet数据集上培训的Vit-B(86M参数)模型和在16.89亿个图像的LVD-1689M网络尺度数据集上培训的DINov3原模型的Vit-L变体(从Vit-7B上分离出).
虽然网络尺度数据可能包含一些生物医学或与病理相关的图像,但预计这些内容仅能代表LVD-1689M的一小部分,而LVD-1689M主要由自然图像组成.
因此,ImageNet-ViT-B提供了小型自然图像模型的下限基线,而DINOv3-LVD-1689M-ViT-L则提供了与建筑相匹配的一般视觉基础模型的有力基线.

blocks.en: 5.2 Downstream Tasks
blocks.zh: 5.2 下游任务

blocks.en:
We evaluated the PFMs outlined in Table 1 on a comprehensive set of 18 non-clinical and 9 clinical downstream tasks across various species, indications, tissues, and magnifications.
The types of tasks included patch classification, slide classification, and segmentation. Table 2 shows an overview of the downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了表1中概述的一套跨各种物种、迹象、组织和放大的18个非临床和9个临床下游任务。
任务类型包括补丁分级,幻灯片分级分级. 表2显示了下游任务的概况。

blocks.en: Table 2: Overview of non-clinical and clinical downstream tasks for evaluation of PFMs.
blocks.zh: 表2:PFM评价的非临床和临床下游任务概述.

blocks.en:
Non-Clinical Downstream Tasks. 19,935 WSIs from 289 studies across all six species were used as an evaluation dataset to design downstream tasks for model evaluation.
The evaluation dataset was completely independent and there was no overlap with the WSIs in the TOX-FM-100K and TOX-FM-1M training datasets.
The WSIs were paired with either metadata containing species and tissue information or pathologists’ annotations for artifacts and lesions, which were used to obtain labels for the respective tasks.
The pathologists’ annotations were constrained to a region of interest in the WSI and exhaustively annotated within the region using QuPath open-source software for digital pathology image analysis [ 51 ] .
Annotated artifacts were related to slide quality issues caused during slide preparation or scanning, while annotated lesions were related to drug- or disease-induced pathological findings in the tissue.
blocks.zh:
非临床下游任务. 19 935 (英语). 来自所有六个物种的289个研究的WSI被用作评价数据集来设计模型评价的下游任务.
评价数据集是完全独立的,在TOX-FM-100K和TOX-FM-1M训练数据集中与WSI没有重叠.
世界安全研究所与包含物种和组织信息的元数据或病理学家的文物和损伤说明进行了配对,这些说明用于获得有关任务的标签。
病理学家的说明被限制在对世界安全倡议感兴趣的区域,并使用QuPath开源软件在区域内进行数字病理学图像分析[51]。
附加说明的文物与幻灯片制作或扫描过程中产生的幻灯片质量问题有关,而附加说明的损伤与组织中药物或疾病引起的病理发现有关。

blocks.en:
The non-clinical tasks were designed to encompass a range of task-appropriate magnifications.
Species and tissue tasks were performed at lower magnifications, specifically at 4.0 and 2.0 mpp, respectively, as they are primarily associated with global semantic features of the image.
Artifact and lesion tasks were performed at higher magnifications, specifically at 1.0 and 0.5 mpp, respectively, as they are primarily associated with local spatial features of the image. Figures 3 B and 3 C show some examples of the artifacts and lesions present in WSIs.
blocks.zh:
非临床任务旨在包括一系列适合任务的放大。
物种和组织任务在下放大时完成,具体分别为4.0和2.0 mpp,因为它们主要与图像的全球语义特征有关.
人工活化和损伤工作是在更高的放大度下完成的,具体分别为1.0和0.5 mpp,因为它们主要与图像的局部空间特征有关. 图3 B和图3 C显示了世界安全研究所中的一些文物和损伤。

blocks.en:
Following the established best practices for assessing PFMs [ 11 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 46 ] , we designed all tasks as patch classification tasks using linear probe evaluation.
For improved performance on artifact and lesion tasks, we also applied attention probe evaluation using attention-based multiple instance learning (ABMIL) [ 52 ] to aggregate patch token embeddings for patch classification.
For improved performance on species and tissue tasks, we also designed slide classification tasks using ABMIL to aggregate embeddings across multiple patches sampled from a WSI.
Finally, we designed artifact and lesion segmentation tasks using a simple U-Net decoder [ 53 ] .
blocks.zh:
按照评估PFM的既定最佳做法[11,13,14,15,16,46],我们利用线性探测评价,将所有任务设计为补丁分类任务.
为了改进文物和损伤任务方面的性能,我们还利用基于注意力的多实例学习(ABMIL)[52]应用了注意力探测评估,以汇总补丁符号嵌入来进行补丁分类.
为了改进物种和组织任务的性能,我们还利用ABMIL设计了滑行分类任务,将嵌入物聚合到从WSI取样的多块补丁上.
最后,我们用简单的U-Net解码器设计出文物和损伤分解任务[53].

blocks.en:
For each task, the relevant WSIs were split into training and testing datasets, and patches (256 × 256 pixels) were sampled accordingly from the WSIs.
Classification tasks were designed to be balanced across classes.
To enable fair comparison between models, we performed a hyperparameter sweep across different learning rates and weight decays where applicable.
We report the performance from the best hyperparameter combination, which was determined by monitoring performance on a constant batch that was held out from the training dataset for the task.
We report the macro F1 metric for classification tasks and the mean intersection-over-union (mIOU) metric for segmentation tasks.
blocks.zh:
在每项任务中,相关的WSI被分为培训和测试数据集,并相应从WSI中抽取补丁(256×256像素).
分类任务旨在平衡各阶层的情况。
为了能够在模型之间进行公平比较,我们对不同的学习率和适当的体重衰减进行了超参数扫描。
我们从最佳超参数组合中报告业绩,这是通过监测从任务培训数据集中抽取的恒定批量业绩来确定的。
我们报告分类任务的宏 F1 度量衡和分区任务的平均交叉-交叉(mIOU)度量衡。

blocks.en:
All PFMs were frozen for evaluation and only the respective probes were trained for the downstream tasks.
All linear probe patch classification tasks and slide classification tasks used the concatenation of the CLS token and mean of the patch token embeddings of the ViT model.
All attention probe patch classification tasks and segmentation tasks used the patch token embeddings of the ViT model.
blocks.zh:
所有PFM被冻结用于评估,只有相应的探测器接受了下游任务的培训.
所有线性探针补丁分类任务和滑行分类任务都采用了CLS代号的通配和VIT模型嵌入补丁代号的平均值.
所有注意探针补丁分类任务和分解任务都使用了VIT模型的补丁符嵌入.

blocks.en:
Clinical Downstream Tasks. We adopted the eva open-source foundation model evaluation framework for oncology [ 46 ] and included all accessible pathology datasets.
We followed all evaluation protocols and metrics as defined in the official eva repository [ 54 ] .
blocks.zh:
下游临床 任务 我们采用了用于肿瘤学的eva开源基础模型评价框架[46],并包括所有可获取的病理数据集。
我们遵循了官方eva寄存器所定义的所有评价协议和衡量标准[54].

blocks.en:
Note that the eva evaluation protocol specifies constant default hyperparameters.
To enable fair comparison between models, we performed a hyperparameter sweep across different learning rates and weight decays where applicable.
We report the performance from the best hyperparameter combination, similar to the evaluation protocol described for non-clinical tasks.
Overall, this improved performance by approximately 1 – 4% compared to the metrics reported on the official leaderboard for the clinical PFMs.
blocks.zh:
注意eva评价协议指定了常数默认超参数.
为了能够在模型之间进行公平比较,我们对不同的学习率和适当的体重衰减进行了超参数扫描。
我们从最好的超参数组合报告性能,类似于描述的非临床任务的评价协议.
总体来说,与临床PFM官方领导板上报告的衡量标准相比,这一表现提高了约1-4%。

blocks.en: More details of the hyperparameters are provided in Appendix 2 .
blocks.zh: 超参数的更详细情况见附录2。

blocks.en: 6 Results
blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en: 6.1 Performance of Non-Clinical and Clinical PFMs
blocks.zh: 6.1 非临床和临床PFM的性能

blocks.en:
Figure 3 A shows the overall performance of all models across the non-clinical and clinical downstream tasks.
More details of the performance on individual tasks are provided in Appendix 3 .
blocks.zh:
图3 A显示所有模型在非临床和临床下游任务中的整体性能.
附录3详细介绍了各项任务的执行情况。

Figure 3: (A) Distribution of task weights and overall performance (mean and standard deviation) of all models across a comprehensive set of 18 non-clinical and 9 clinical downstream tasks. (B) Examples of attention weights from attention probe evaluation for the artifact patch classification non-clinical task using embeddings from TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL.
The attention weights were used to aggregate the patch token embeddings for patch classification. (C) Examples of segmentation masks for the lesion segmentation non-clinical task using embeddings from TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL.

图3 (A) 18个非临床任务和9个临床下游任务中所有模型的任务权重分布和总体性能(平均与标准偏差). (B) 利用从TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL的嵌入物进行文物补丁分类非临床任务的注意力探测评价的注意力分量实例.
注意分量用于聚合补丁符号嵌入来进行补丁分类. (C) 利用从TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL的嵌入物,为损伤分解非临床任务提供分解口罩的例子。

blocks.en:
Overall, domain-specific models achieve superior performance on their respective domain-specific tasks, with TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL demonstrating the best performance across the non-clinical PFMs and Midnight-12k demonstrating the best performance across the clinical PFMs.
Notably, cross-domain performance remains remarkably competitive across both non-clinical and clinical PFMs.
Specifically, the best cross-domain model achieves approximately 95% relative performance compared to the strongest domain-specific model and 98% relative performance compared to the weakest domain-specific model, suggesting effective cross-domain generalization.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,专有域的模型在各自的专有域任务上取得了优异的性能,TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL演示了全非临床PFM的最好性能和Midnight-12k演示了全临床PFM的最好性能.
值得注意的是,在非临床和临床的PFM中,跨领域性能仍然非常有竞争力。
具体而言,与最强域特异性模型相比,最佳跨域模型的相对性能约为95%,与最弱域特异性模型相比,相对性能约为98%,这表明有效的跨域通论.

blocks.en:
Figure 1 shows examples of the feature maps of Midnight-12k and TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL across different domains and scales using PCA visualization techniques, whereby the features are projected into 3 dimensions and visualized in RGB space [ 22 ] .
Across both non-clinical and clinical images, TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL produces high-quality feature maps, capturing the semantic similarity of tissue morphology at different spatial locations across the images.
Similarly, Midnight-12k also generates structured and informative feature maps, although some examples appear less spatially coherent by visual inspection.
However, PCA feature map visualizations are qualitative and projection-dependent, so visual coherence is not necessarily a direct measure of downstream utility or predictive accuracy.
We note that Midnight-12k was trained using the DINOv2 framework which uses learnable positional embeddings, which are interpolated to process images at varying resolutions.
In contrast, TOX-FM models were trained using rotary positional embeddings [ 55 ] , which enables the models to process images at varying resolutions without requiring adaptation.
Therefore, while the PCA feature maps in Figure 1 are visualized at different resolutions to support qualitative analysis across multiple scales, additional examples of the PCA feature maps at the training resolution of 256 × 256 pixels are provided in Appendix 3 .
blocks.zh:
图1显示了使用PCA可视化技术跨越不同领域和尺度的"Midnight-12k"和"TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL"地物图的例子,其中地物被投射到3维并被可视化于RGB空间 [22].
在整个非临床和临床图像中,TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL制作出高质量的地物图,捕捉出不同地段在图像上方不同空间位置的组织形态的语义相似性.
同样地,Midnight-12k还生成有条理和内容丰富的地物地图,尽管通过视觉检查,一些例子在空间上似乎不太一致.
然而,PCA地物映射可视化具有定性和投影依赖性,因此视觉一致性并不一定是下游效用或预测精度的直接衡量.
我们注意到,Midnight-12k是使用DINov2框架培训的,该框架使用可学习的定位嵌入,这些嵌入被插入处理不同分辨率的图像。
相比之下,TOX-FM模型是通过旋转位置嵌入来训练的 [55] ,这使得模型能够按不同分辨率处理图像而无需修改.
因此,虽然图1中的常设仲裁法院特征图在不同分辨率上可视化,以支持多个尺度的定性分析,但附录3提供了256×256像素的培训分辨率中的常设仲裁法院特征图的其他实例。

blocks.en:
Across the non-clinical tasks, we observe that the clinical PFMs tend to show the biggest gaps in performance on species and tissue tasks, which are performed at lower magnifications, while the performance remains more competitive on artifact and lesion tasks, which are performed at higher magnifications.
Lower magnifications capture tissue-level architecture and organization, which exhibit greater differences between human and animal tissues, and may have lower transferability from the clinical to non-clinical domain.
At higher magnifications, the distinctions between human and animal tissues are progressively reduced as cell-level details become the focus, resulting in stronger cross-domain transferability.
We note that Prov-GigaPath and H-optimus-0 were trained exclusively on a single magnification at 0.5 mpp.
While the underlying self-supervised learning frameworks [ 7 , 10 ] do implicitly learn multi-scale features through global and local cropping and scaling augmentations, the effective magnification range remains limited, and such augmentations alone are insufficient to capture the intrinsic multi-scale nature of WSIs.
In contrast, models that explicitly include multi-scale datasets sampled at various magnifications such as Midnight-12k and TOX-FM models demonstrate measurably improved performance, particularly when evaluated across broader magnification ranges.
blocks.zh:
在整个非临床任务中,我们观察到临床PFM往往显示出物种和组织任务在性能上的最大差距,这些任务是在更低的放大度下完成的,而性能在文物和损伤任务上仍然更具竞争力,这些任务是在更高的放大度下完成的.
更低的放大能捕捉到组织层次的架构和组织,显示人类和动物组织之间的差异较大,并且从临床领域到非临床领域的可转移性可能更低.
在更高的放大度下,随着细胞级细节成为焦点,人和动物组织之间的区别会逐渐缩小,从而增强跨域可转移性.
我们注意到,Prov-Gigapath和H-opimus-0只接受了0.5毫平分的一次放大训练。
虽然基本的自我监督的学习框架[7,10]确实通过全球和地方的收割和扩增而隐含地学习了多尺度特征,但有效的放大范围仍然有限,光是这种扩增不足以反映世界安全倡议的内在多尺度性质。
相形之下,明确包含在"午夜-12k"和"TOX-FM"等各种放大度中取样的多尺度数据集的模型,显示出显著的改进性能,特别是在跨更广阔的放大范围评价时.

blocks.en:
While linear probe evaluation remains a strong baseline for assessing PFMs, attention probe evaluation significantly improves performance for spatially resolved patch classification tasks.
Specifically, using attention probe evaluation, Midnight-12k demonstrates a relative performance improvement of 18% and 10% on artifact and lesion tasks, respectively.
TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL demonstrates an even larger relative performance improvement of 27% and 13%, respectively, suggesting that the patch token embeddings encode strong representations which can be appropriately leveraged using attention probe evaluation, but may be diminished when simply averaged for linear probe evaluation. Figure 3 B shows examples of the attention weights from attention probe evaluation using embeddings from TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL, whereby the relative importance of the patch token embeddings correlates well with the location of the artifacts.
blocks.zh:
虽然线性探测器评价仍然是评估PFM的有力基线,但注意力探测器评价大大提高了空间解决的补丁分类任务的性能.
具体地说,Midnight-12k利用注意力探测器评估显示,在文物和损伤任务方面,相对性能提高了18%和10%。
TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL显示相对性能分别提高了27%和13%,这表明补丁符号嵌入了能使用注意力探测器评价适当利用的强表示值,但在简单的线性探测器评价平均值时可能会减少。 图 3个 B展示了使用从TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL嵌入法进行的注意力探测器评价的注意力分量,由此,补丁符号嵌入的相对重要性与文物的位置有着很好的关联.

blocks.en: 6.2 Model Size
blocks.zh: 6.2 型号大小

blocks.en:
Our experiments on scaling model size provide further insights into the performance characteristics of PFMs.
First, scaling model size without dataset diversity appears to lead to overfitting and degraded cross-domain performance.
Specifically, when scaling from TOX-FM-100K-ViT-L to TOX-FM-100K-ViT-H, we observe that overall performance improves on non-clinical tasks but decreases on clinical tasks.
However, jointly scaling model size and dataset diversity, as in TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H, improves the overall performance across both sets of tasks.
These observations also highlight the importance of broad and comprehensive evaluations for accurately characterizing the scope and limitations of PFMs.
Without assessing the performance on clinical tasks, it may have been incorrectly assumed that scaling model size universally improves downstream performance, while the effects of overfitting would have remained unrecognized.
blocks.zh:
我们对模型尺寸的缩放实验,进一步深入了解了PFM的性能特征.
首先,没有数据集多样性的模型大小的缩放似乎导致跨域性能过度适应和退化.
具体地说,当从TOX-FM-100K-ViT-L缩放到TOX-FM-100K-ViT-H时,我们看到总体性能在非临床任务上有所改进,但在临床任务上却有所降低.
然而,像TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H中那样,联合缩放模型大小和数据集多样性,提高了两套任务的总体性能.
这些意见还突出了广泛而全面的评价对准确描述可持续森林管理的范围和局限性的重要性。
如果不评估临床任务的表现,人们可能错误地认为,规模模型的大小普遍改善下游的性能,而过度适应的影响却一直得不到承认。

blocks.en:
We also found that the smaller model size of the non-clinical PFMs compared to the clinical PFMs does not appear to constrain performance on downstream tasks at this stage.
Specifically, despite TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL being 60% of the size of Midnight-12k, both models exhibit comparable cross-domain performance as detailed above.
Alternatively, if model capacity was a bottleneck, we would expect non-clinical PFMs to perform substantially worse on clinical tasks than clinical PFMs do on non-clinical tasks, yet this asymmetry is not observed.
blocks.zh:
我们还发现,与临床的PFM相比,非临床PFM的模型尺寸较小,在现阶段似乎并不限制下游任务的表现.
具体来说,尽管TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL是"午夜-12k"大小的60%,但如上所详述的,这两个模型都表现出了可比的跨域性能.
或者,如果模型能力是一个瓶颈,我们期望非临床PFM在临床任务上的表现会比临床PFM在非临床任务上的表现要糟糕得多,然而这种不对称却没有被观察到.

blocks.en: 6.3 Dataset Diversity
blocks.zh: 6.3 数据集多样性

blocks.en:
Our experiments on scaling dataset diversity demonstrate a difference in the impact on domain-specific and cross-domain downstream tasks.
Specifically, scaling from TOX-FM-100K-ViT-H to TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H yielded more pronounced performance gains on clinical tasks than on non-clinical tasks.
Motivated by observations from the natural image domain, we hypothesize that this is related to the difference in distributional proximity between the training and task datasets [ 56 ] .
Under this assumption, TOX-FM-100K , despite being limited to rat studies, may already provide sufficient task-relevant diversity and effective representations for many of the non-clinical tasks, for which rat was the dominant species.
Moreover, the pathologists’ annotations for artifacts and lesions were primarily performed on rat WSIs from recent studies, so the additional diversity across species, studies, and variation in staining and scanning protocols offered by TOX-FM-1M may be less relevant for these tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们关于扩大数据集多样性的实验表明,对特定领域和跨领域下游任务的影响不同。
具体而言,从TOX-FM-100K-ViT-H到TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H,在临床任务上比在非临床任务上取得了更显著的性能收益.
根据自然图像域的观测结果,我们假设这与培训与任务数据集之间的分布相近性差异有关[56]。
根据这一假设,TOX-FM-100K尽管仅限于鼠类研究,但可能已经为许多非临床任务提供了足够的与任务相关的多样性和有效表述,而鼠类是其中的主要物种.
此外,病理学家对文物和损伤的说明主要是根据最近研究的老鼠的WSI进行的,因此,TOX-FM-1M提供的物种、研究、污渍和扫描协议的更多多样性可能与这些任务不太相关。

blocks.en:
We performed a quantitative analysis to validate the assumption that TOX-FM-100K is distributionally closer to the non-clinical tasks than TOX-FM-1M .
First, to make the analysis computationally tractable, random subsets of 100,000 patches were generated from each of TOX-FM-100K , TOX-FM-1M , the non-clinical task datasets, and the clinical task datasets.
To ensure that each subset was representative of the complete dataset, subsets were stratified across magnifications, tasks, and classes where applicable.
Next, following the standard practice for measuring distances between data distributions [ 57 ] , we embedded each subset and calculated the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) with a radial basis function (RBF) kernel [ 58 ] , sliced Wasserstein distance [ 59 ] , and Fréchet distance [ 60 ] between the training and task subsets in the embedding space.
blocks.zh:
我们进行了定量分析,以证实TOX-FM-100K在分布上比TOX-FM-1M更接近非临床任务的假设.
首先,为了使分析具有可计算可拉动性,从TOX-FM-100K,TOX-FM-1M,非临床任务数据集,临床任务数据集中,都产生了十万个补丁的随机子集.
为确保每个子集都代表完整的数据集,子集按放大、任务和适用类别进行分级。
接下来,按照测量数据分布相距的标准做法[57],我们嵌入了每个子集,并计算出最大平均相距(MMD),并具有射线基础函数(RBF)内核[58],切开了Wasserstein相距[59],并计算出嵌入空间中训练和任务相距[60].

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows the pairwise distribution distances between the training and task datasets.
To ensure that the results were not biased by the choice of embedding space, we repeated the analysis using embeddings from six models across the natural image, clinical, and non-clinical domains.
Overall, the smallest distances across all metrics and embedding spaces are between TOX-FM-100K and the non-clinical tasks, consistent with our hypothesis.
Additionally, the distances between the training datasets and clinical tasks are considerably larger than those of non-clinical tasks, supporting the view that the clinical tasks constitute a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark for non-clinical PFMs.
UMAP visualizations of the datasets across all embedding spaces are provided in Appendix 4 .

总体而言,所有度量和嵌入空间之间的最小距离是在TOX-FM-100K与非临床任务之间,这符合我们的假设.

blocks.en:
Therefore, while previous work has emphasized the positive effect of distributional proximity and demonstrated the limited effect of dataset diversity on downstream tasks beyond the training distribution [ 56 ] , our findings suggest that both distributional proximity and dataset diversity may play different roles depending on the magnitude of the distribution shift.
In the low-shift regime, distributional proximity remains the dominant factor for performance on downstream tasks.
However, in the high-shift regime, we observe that training with the more diverse non-clinical TOX-FM-1M improves the performance on clinical tasks, suggesting that dataset diversity can enhance cross-domain performance even when distributional proximity is absent.
blocks.zh:
因此,虽然以前的工作强调分布相近的积极影响,并表明数据集多样性对培训分布之外的下游任务的有限影响[56],但我们的研究结果表明,分布相近和数据集多样性可能根据分布相移的程度发挥不同的作用。
在低班制中,分布相近仍然是执行下游任务的主要因素。
然而,在高班制度下,我们观察到,使用更加多样化的非临床TOX-FM-1M的培训可以改善临床任务的表现,这表明数据集的多样性即使在没有分布相近的情况下也能提高跨域性能.

blocks.en:
Motivated by recent work on the convergence of representations across models trained using different datasets, methods, and modalities [ 61 ] , we further examined whether scaling dataset diversity is associated with the convergence of non-clinical and clinical PFMs, thereby providing a potential explanation for the observed cross-domain generalization of TOX-FM models.
Specifically, we measured the representation similarity of TOX-FM models with respect to Midnight-12k and H-optimus-0, the two best performing clinical PFMs on clinical tasks.
We calculated the centered kernel alignment (CKA) [ 62 ] and mutual k-nearest neighbors (kNN) [ 61 ] metrics with null calibration [ 63 ] , which capture global and local representation similarity, respectively.
The metrics were calculated using random, stratified subsets of 100,000 patches from the clinical task datasets. Figure 5 shows the representation similarity metrics between non-clinical and clinical PFMs.
Overall, both global and local representation similarities increase alongside training dataset diversity, highlighting the increased representation convergence between non-clinical and clinical PFMs and consistent with the overall best cross-domain performance demonstrated by TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en:
We present TOX-FM, a family of non-clinical PFMs trained using the DINOv3 self-supervised learning framework on large-scale diverse histopathology datasets spanning a broad range of animal toxicology studies.
We evaluate TOX-FM and state-of-the-art clinical PFMs on a comprehensive set of 18 non-clinical and 9 clinical downstream tasks, addressing key open questions regarding the role of domain-specific training and the capability of cross-domain generalization of PFMs between human and animal tissues.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍TOX-FM,这是一个使用DINOv3自我监督的学习框架培训的非临床PFM的大家庭,涉及涵盖广泛的动物毒理学研究的大规模多样化组织病理学数据集。
我们对TOX-FM和最先进的临床PFM进行一套综合的18个非临床任务和9个临床下游任务的评价,解决关于特定领域培训的作用以及人与动物组织之间跨领域通用PFM的能力的关键开放问题。

blocks.en:
TOX-FM models showed the best performance on non-clinical downstream tasks, while clinical PFMs showed the best performance on clinical downstream tasks.
This advantage of domain-specific training is further emphasized by the computational efficiency of the ViT-L and ViT-H TOX-FM models, which demonstrate superior performance on non-clinical tasks with only 30 – 60% of the model capacity of ViT-g clinical PFMs.
While domain-specific models remain optimal, the cross-domain generalization capabilities of both non-clinical and clinical PFMs are notable, although transferability varies based on the type of tasks and the magnification at which the tasks are performed.
Further evaluation across both non-clinical and clinical domains, including broadening the scope and complexity of tasks across species, indications, tissues, and magnifications would be important to better understand where domain-specific models are necessary and where cross-domain models may be a viable alternative if domain-specific options are unavailable.
We also highlight the importance of dataset diversity, which exhibited a stronger impact than model size, especially on cross-domain performance.
blocks.zh:
TOX-FM模型显示了非临床下游任务的最佳性能,而临床PFM则显示了临床下游任务的最佳性能.
VIT-L和VIT-H TOX-FM模型的计算效率进一步强调了域特异性培训的这一优势,这些模型在非临床任务上表现出了优异的性能,只有30–60%的VIT-g临床PFM模型容量.
虽然域特异性模型仍然是最优化的,但非临床和临床PFM的跨域通化能力都值得注意,尽管可转移性因任务类型和执行任务的放大而有所不同.
对非临床和临床领域的进一步评价,包括扩大不同物种、指标、组织和放大的任务范围和复杂性,对于更好地了解在哪些领域需要特定领域模型,以及在没有特定领域选项的情况下,跨领域模型可能是一个可行的替代办法,将是很重要的。
我们还强调数据集多样性的重要性,它显示出比模型规模更大的影响,特别是对跨领域业绩的影响。

blocks.en:
To the best of our knowledge, we have provided the first analysis of cross-domain performance of PFMs across the non-clinical and clinical domains.
The evidence of bidirectional cross-domain generalization observed in our evaluations suggests that PFMs learn domain-invariant representations that capture fundamental cellular or morphological features that are conserved across species.
This could be particularly valuable in translational research, where a major challenge is the limited translatability of preclinical findings to clinical outcomes, resulting in many drug candidates failing to reach patients.
By providing a potentially transferable representation space, non-clinical PFMs have the potential to bridge this gap and support the discovery and development of more robust predictors of clinical outcomes at earlier stages of the process.
blocks.zh:
据我们所知,我们提供了跨非临床和临床领域PFM跨领域性能的第一次分析。
我们的评价中观察到的双向跨域通论的证据表明,PFMs学习了域-不变量的表示法,能够捕捉各个物种所保存的基本细胞或形态特征.
这在翻译研究中可能特别有价值,在翻译研究中,一个重大挑战是临床前的研究结果对临床结果的可转换性有限,导致许多药物考生无法接触到患者.
非临床PFM通过提供潜在的可转移的表示空间,有可能弥合这一差距,支持发现和发展更可靠的临床结果预测器。

blocks.en:
We also highlight the impact of distributional proximity and dataset diversity on downstream performance.
In line with previous work [ 56 ] , we show that distributional proximity between the training and task datasets appears to be the dominant factor for performance on downstream tasks in the low-shift regime.
However, in contrast to previous work from the natural image domain [ 56 ] , we show that dataset diversity can improve cross-domain performance in the high-shift regime in the histopathology domain, as demonstrated by the strong performance of non-clinical PFMs trained on more diverse non-clinical datasets on clinical downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们还强调分布相近和数据集多样性对下游业绩的影响。
根据先前的工作[56],我们表明,培训与任务数据集之间的分布相近似乎是低班制下游任务业绩的主要因素。
然而,与之前来自自然图像域的作品相去甚远[56],我们显示数据集多样性可以改善组织病理学域中高相位制中的跨域性能,这表现在非临床PFM在临床下游任务的更多样化非临床数据集上受到训练的强效性能上.

blocks.en:
TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL emerged as the overall best TOX-FM model, leveraging a continual pre-training strategy to effectively integrate knowledge from datasets collected at two different phases while maintaining efficient use of computational resources.
We plan to use this scalable framework to continue incorporating new datasets as additional WSIs become available from future toxicology studies.
More broadly, this highlights the value of continual learning approaches, which have become increasingly important amid the rapid growth of data and the expanding scale of foundation model development.
Recent studies have proposed and evaluated a range of continual learning paradigms, focusing on the critical balance between plasticity and stability, as well as demonstrating the adaptability, efficiency, and sustainability of these methods [ 43 , 64 ] .
blocks.zh:
TOX-FM-1M-ViT-H-CL成为总体最好的TOX-FM模式,利用持续的培训前战略,有效地整合从两个不同阶段收集的数据集中获取的知识,同时保持对计算资源的有效利用。
我们计划利用这一可扩展的框架,随着未来毒理学研究获得更多的世界安全指数,继续纳入新的数据集。
更广泛地说,这突出了持续学习方法的价值,随着数据的迅速增长和基础模型开发规模的扩大,这些方法变得越来越重要。
最近的研究提出并评价了一系列持续学习的范式,重点是可塑性和稳定性之间的关键平衡,以及展示这些方法的适应性、效率和可持续性[43、64]。

blocks.en:
We investigated Gram anchoring to improve dense feature representations for spatially resolved downstream tasks, including classification tasks focusing on artifacts and lesions, which may be very small, as well as segmentation tasks.
Although we visually observed refinement of the dense feature representations with Gram anchoring, the impact on performance across the various non-clinical and clinical downstream tasks remains nuanced and task dependent.
Additional analysis would be informative and help provide clarity on where Gram anchoring offers the greatest benefits in histopathology applications, specifically.

我们调查了格莱姆锚地情况,以改进用于空间解决的下游任务的密集地特征表示,包括侧重于可能非常小的文物和损伤的分类任务以及分块任务。
尽管我们看到了用克拉姆锚地对密集特征表述的改进,但对各种非临床和临床下游任务的业绩的影响仍然细微并取决于任务。
补充分析将提供信息,并有助于明确格莱克锚定在哪些方面在组织病理学应用中可带来最大好处。

blocks.en:
Building on these advances, a promising next step is the development of PFMs trained on integrated non-clinical and clinical datasets.
By leveraging complementary information across domains, the current strengths of domain-specific models may be combined and support broader generalization.
We plan to further investigate this direction in future work.
One potential approach would be to curate harmonized datasets that include both non-clinical and clinical resources.
For example, clinical datasets such as The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) [ 65 ] could be combined with TOX-FM datasets, with the dataset curation and sampling strategy applied to ensure balanced contributions across both domains.
Alternatively, the continual learning approach could be extended across domains.
For example, TOX-FM models could be continually pre-trained on TCGA, or clinical PFMs could be further adapted using TOX-FM datasets.
blocks.zh:
在这些进展的基础上,下一个有希望的步骤是开发关于综合非临床和临床数据集的PFM。
通过利用各领域的互补信息,可以将特定领域模式的当前优势结合起来,支持更广泛的概括。
我们计划在今后的工作中进一步调查这一方向。
一种可能的办法将是整理包括非临床和临床资源的统一数据集。
例如,诸如 " 癌症基因组图集 " [65]等临床数据集可与TOX-FM数据集结合,并采用数据集的校正和取样战略,以确保两个领域的贡献均衡。
或者,可以将持续学习方法推广到各个领域。
例如,TOX-FM模型可以在TCGA上持续进行预训,也可以使用TOX-FM数据集进一步调整临床PFM.

blocks.en:
While vision models continue to dominate the landscape of PFMs, multimodal foundation models developed by aligning histopathology with complementary modalities are emerging as a promising direction.
Vision-language PFMs integrate histopathology with associated text from scientific textbooks, research articles, clinical reports, online educational platforms, and disease ontologies [ 66 , 67 , 68 , 69 , 70 ] .
Vision-omics PFMs combine histopathology with matched gene expression profiles from sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics technologies, such as Visium and Xenium [ 71 , 72 ] .
However, most development and validation efforts remain focused on clinical applications, especially oncology, and further investigations of multimodal PFMs focused on the non-clinical domain remain an important area of research.
Notably, pathologists’ reports in toxicology studies contain descriptions of animal pathology findings, the Standard for Exchange of Non-clinical Data provides a framework for controlled terminology, and existing datasets pairing histopathology with spatial transcriptomics include samples from animal species, primarily mouse [ 73 , 74 ] .
Together, these resources may pave the way for more systematic development and validation of multimodal non-clinical PFMs, enabling the characterization of complex toxicity mechanisms across multiple biological scales and contexts.

blocks.en:
In this work, we address a critical gap in the development of foundation models for histopathology through the introduction of TOX-FM, a family of non-clinical PFMs trained on large-scale diverse histopathology datasets of over one million WSIs consisting of over 60 organs across six animal species from over 14,000 toxicology studies across six decades.
As PFMs continue to advance, rigorous understanding of the strengths and limitations of both non-clinical and clinical models is essential to fully leverage these tools to accelerate drug development and enable effective translation from preclinical to clinical stages and beyond.
Towards this goal, TOX-FM establishes a benchmark for non-clinical PFMs while providing early insights into cross-domain generalization capabilities of existing clinical PFMs.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们通过引进TOX-FM,解决了在建立组织病理学基础模型方面的一个重大差距,TOX-FM是一个非临床的PFM家族,经过培训,拥有100多万个由6个动物物种的60多个器官组成的大型多种组织病理学数据集,来自60年来14 000多起毒理学研究。
随着PFM的不断推进,严格了解非临床和临床模型的优点和局限性,对于充分利用这些工具来加快药物开发,并使得从临床前阶段到临床阶段及以后的有效翻译成为关键.
为实现这一目标,TOX-FM为非临床性PFM建立了基准,同时为现有临床性PFM的跨域通化能力提供早期的见解.

blocks.en: Appendix Appendix 1: Hierarchical K-means
blocks.zh: 附录1:分级K类

blocks.en:
The dataset curation method for TOX-FM-1M used consistent settings for hierarchical k-means across all magnifications.
To decrease storage and computational requirements, we used PCA to project the CLS token embeddings from Midnight-12k from 1536 into 256 dimensions for the highest magnification (0.5 mpp) and 512 for all other magnifications.
Then, we applied k-means clustering with 4 bottom-up levels of 100K, 10K, 1K, and 30 clusters, respectively.
At each magnification, the target subset size was determined based on the desired sampling ratio, which we set as 25% of all candidate patches at the lowest magnification (4.0 mpp) and 50% for all other magnifications.
Note that candidate patches at the lowest magnification consist of all non-overlapping patches from tissue regions from all WSIs, while candidate patches at each subsequent magnification are conditioned on selected patches at the preceding magnification.
The target subset size was recursively allocated across clusters in the hierarchy, beginning at the top-level of 30 clusters.
blocks.zh:
TOX-FM-1M的数据集校正方法使用一致的设置,用于所有放大的分级k-表示.
为了降低存储和计算要求,我们使用PCA将CLS符从"午夜-12k"从1536年投放到256维来进行最高放大(0.5 mpp)和512来进行所有其他放大.
然后,我们应用了k-意指集群,4个自下而上的水平分别为100K,10K,1K和30个集群.
在每次放大时,目标子集大小是根据理想的采样比例确定的,我们设定在最小放大(4.0 mpp)时占所有候选补丁的25%,而所有其他放大则占50%.
请注意,最小放大时的候选补丁由来自所有WSI组织区域的所有非重叠补丁组成,而后续每次放大时的候选补丁则以上次放大时选定的补丁为条件.
目标子集大小是从30个集群的顶层开始,在分级中逐级分配。

blocks.en:
We performed a small-scale validation analysis on a subset of 36,000 rat WSIs for which corresponding tissue information was available.
For the validation analysis, we applied hierarchical k-means independently on all patches at each magnification (without applying the progressive multi-scale strategy) with a fixed sampling ratio of 25%. Figure A1 shows the distribution of the candidate and selected patches across tissue types.
We observe that rare tissue types are generally oversampled ( ≥ \geq 25%) relative to the sampling ratio, while more common tissue types are generally sampled close to or slightly lower ( < < 25%) than the sampling ratio.
Notably, while the method does not utilize the tissue metadata in any way, it produces clusters that seem to capture meaningful diversity across tissue phenotypes.

我们对36 000只小鼠的WSI进行了小规模验证分析,已有相应的组织信息。
为了进行验证分析,我们在每次放大时(不应用渐进式多尺度策略)对所有补丁独立应用了分级k-表示,固定的采样比例为25%. 图A1显示了候选人和所选补丁在组织类型上的分布.
我们观察到,相对于取样比率,稀有组织类型一般被过度取样(\\\ geq 25%),而更常见的组织类型一般被取样接近或略低于( < 25%)的样本。
值得注意的是,虽然该方法不以任何方式利用组织元数据,但它产生的集群似乎能够捕捉到不同组织酚类之间有意义的多样性。

blocks.zh: 表A5和A6分别显示TOX-FM模型的性能以及空间解析的非临床(艺术和损伤)和临床(分块)下游任务的对应-奶奶模型.

blocks.en:
Table A5: Average performance (mean and standard deviation) of TOX-FM models and the corresponding -Gram models on artifact and lesion non-clinical downstream tasks.
Performance is reported based on macro F1 for classification tasks and mIOU for segmentation tasks.
Performance is averaged across multiple runs.
blocks.zh:
表A5:TOX-FM模型和相应的-Gram模型关于文物和损伤的非临床下游任务的平均性能(平均与标准偏差).
业绩报告基于分类任务的宏F1和分区任务的mIOU.
业绩在多个运行中平均。

blocks.en:
Table A6: Average performance (mean and standard deviation) of TOX-FM models and the corresponding -Gram models on segmentation clinical downstream tasks.
Performance is reported based on metrics as defined in the official eva repository.
Performance is averaged across multiple runs.
blocks.zh:
表A6: TOX-FM模型和相应的-Gram模型在分化临床下游任务上的平均性能(平均与标准偏差).
业绩是根据官方eva存储处界定的衡量标准报告。
业绩在多个运行中平均。

blocks.en: Figures A4 and A5 show examples of PCA feature maps across magnifications and fields of view for different tissues and species.
blocks.zh: 图A4和图A5显示了不同组织和物种的放大和视野的五氯苯甲醚特征图的例子。

blocks.en:
Figure A4: Examples of PCA feature maps across magnifications and concentric fields of view on an H&E WSI of kidney tissue from a rat.
The black boxes on each image indicate the field of view at the next higher magnification.
blocks.zh:
图A4:大鼠肾脏组织H&E WSI上跨放大和同心视野的五氯苯甲醚特征图实例。
每个图像上所显示的黑匣子在下一次高放大时表示视野.

blocks.en:
Figure A5: Examples of PCA feature maps across magnifications and concentric fields of view on an H&E WSI of lung tissue from a monkey.
The black boxes on each image indicate the field of view at the next higher magnification.
blocks.zh:
图A5:猴子肺组织H&E WSI上跨放大和同心视野的五氯苯甲醚特征图实例。
每个图像上所显示的黑匣子在下一次高放大时表示视野.
